title: Wall Street Is Selling to You (The S&P Tells the Truth)
speaker: Arete Trading host

macro_themes.theme: Rotation out of tech into defensives
macro_themes.view: Breadth ratio (S5FI/NDFI) flipped; money leaving semis/optics/software and going to staples, utilities, financials and value (VTV/VUG rising).
The 'OpenAI bar' news last Thursday unlocked doubt about AI circular financing and valuations; take bad news at face value.
Margin debt growth is extreme and net exposure low; forced deleveraging can make declines worse faster than expected.
ASML earnings (Tue night/Wed), CPI and TSMC; a low CPI could improve equity risk premium and spark rotation back into tech; watch Korea overnight.

calls.condition: Could reverse if CPI is very low and ASML bookings are strong

calls.reason: S&P (down ~6-9bp) should outperform Nasdaq on relative basis per breadth ratio, but relative not absolute; both can fall.
